Hi Anna — great to hear. Attaching a compact econ workbook and a draft SOW that maps to how we typically run connector pilots. Key points in the attached 'AtlasBridge_Pilot_Econ_v1.xlsx' (summary below):

- Pilot length: 3 months active + 3 months observation (6 months total)
- Intro credit: Redwood issues a one-time pilot credit that can be applied to invoice for the first invoice (credits do not reduce reported ARR but offset invoices during pilot)
- Intro-credit sizing: $12k credit typical for small pilots; configurable by customer size (see tier table in sheet 'CreditTiers')
- Commission structure: 50% of first-year net subscription for partner-sourced leads; 30% if Redwood sourced but partner introduced (to recognize warm-intros)
- Timebox & clawback: credits are subject to a 6-month clawback if the customer terminates within 90 days of production go-live (scaling clawback %: 100% within 30d, 50% within 31-90d, 0% after 90d)
- Lead registration: 90-day registration window from first qualified outreach; partner must register in HubSpot (link below) with basic contact and qualifying notes

Attached SOW also includes a simple acceptance criteria checklist and a statement that Redwood will provide joint collateral and a technical onboarding hour bank.

Next steps I propose:
1) Anna: confirm the $12k credit and the 50/30 split matrix works for LumenSoft.
2) Ben: please confirm whether finance needs invoice flow change (I believe credits will be posted as contra-invoice line items).
3) Camila: review the clawback wording below and advise edits.

Attachments:
- AtlasBridge_Pilot_Econ_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
- Intro-Credit_SOW_v1.pdf (draft SOW)

Thanks — happy to set a 30-minute call tomorrow to walk through sheets.

Best,

Hannah / Anna — quick readthrough from my side; two suggested edits before we finalize:

1) Lead registration: change to "first-touch capture + 90-day locked window with required HubSpot submission + attach evidence (email thread or demo invite)" — protects partner credits if deal flips.
2) Clawback: add language that clawback is applied pro rata to credit dollars and any unpaid credit balance is invoiced back to partner within 30 days after termination notice. We should also cap total clawback liability to the amount of credits issued.

Also suggest we add a co-sell uplift (5% bonus credit applied if LumenSoft Sales rep is on the signed purchase order and listed as primary AE in HubSpot). That encourages joint motions.

If that sounds OK, Hannah and I can take to legal to bake into the SOW.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
